items.title: Brownout is never a rational choice with homogeneous towers
items.why: N towers at 60% fire rate = 0.6N effective; with a slot-limited board that is always worse than running capacity/draw at full rate. Brownout only becomes a tradeoff with heterogeneous draws (e.g. briefly raising a 40MW shield wall). Verify this holds once anchor-04 unlocks shield-wall.

items.title: Emplacements cannot be sold or upgraded
Sprite emissives still over-driven; drone eye reads white not red
Anchor ring, heavy and mote need silhouette pass at 100% zoom
items.why: They read at contact-sheet size; not verified at in-game size on both light and dark tiles.

items.title: Turret muzzle emissive clips to white
items.why: Amber (1.0,0.62,0.15) at any strength >1 clips the red channel. Needs a desaturated emissive colour, not a lower strength.

items.title: Board tiles read light grey against the dark UI
No contact shadow under units or emplacements
items.why: Nothing is grounded; units look like they float over the board.

items.title: Editor preview shows flat-colour tiles until the project is reloaded, because the Sprites autoload is only instantiated in-editor at startup
HUD and dialog build their Control widgets in code rather than being authored in the scene
Sprite pivot ignores the render camera height_bias, so every sprite draws ~48px above its tile
items.why: Hover highlight and turrets sit off their slot rings. Manifest pivot is (128,128); measured tile silhouette centre is (127.5,176.5). render_pair uses height_bias=0.55 but _measure_tile calibrates at 0.0, so the bias never reaches the pivot

items.title: Frame pacing not reproducible under --fixed-fps
items.why: Two identical --autoplay runs reached different sim states at frame 1800 (coverage 0.306 vs 0.394, wave 6 vs wave 1). Makes screenshot-based art review unreliable; suspect the minf(delta,0.25) clamp absorbing a long first frame

items.title: Sim state diverged twice at a fixed frame while the sprite import cache was stale
items.why: Observed twice (wave 6 vs wave 1 at frame 1800) in runs made after re-rendering but before 'Godot --headless --path . --import'. NOT reproducible since: 12/12 runs now identical, including under CPU load. main.gd now prints STATE frame/sim_t/wave/phase on every --shot, so a recurrence is self-evident rather than inferred from pixels. Reopen only with a STATE line showing sim_t != frame/60

items.title: No sprites for scan-relay, shield-wall or ion-lance — they draw as placeholder polygons
items.why: scan-relay is visible from anchor-02, shield-wall from 04, ion-lance from 06. The sprite manifest has 9 assets and none of them are these three, so three of the five emplacements render as grey diamonds

items.title: Arc node and anchor ring emissives saturate to white in the additive glow layer
items.why: Emission colour is correct in the sprite (cyan-green) but the additive glow pass stacks over the albedo core and clips. Same class as LF-020/022 but in the engine blend, not the render

items.title: Shield wall is overpriced: 40 MW for a 0.45x slow in radius 2.0 is never worth building
items.why: Measured under decision 022 at anchor-04: no-wall wins 10/9/6 lives, wall-always-on loses hard and brutal, optimally-toggled wall loses brutal. Its 40 MW is a 42% overdraw pricing at 62.5%. Either the draw comes down or the effect becomes decisive

items.title: Ion lance is strictly dominated: worse damage per megawatt than the pulse turret even against armour
items.why: Measured: vs plate-4 the lance does 18.3 dps on 34 MW (0.54 per MW), the pulse turret 6.7 dps on 12 MW (0.56 per MW). The designated anti-armour unlock is worse at armour than the starter gun, while costing 3x the funds and draw so it buys fewer emplacements covering less path. Same class as LF-032. Raising damage to 66 fixes brutal but hard still grades single-solution

items.title: anchor-06 Hard Currency is authored but does not grade clean — parked
items.why: Layout is good (path 34 tiles, all 10 slots within 2.0 of the path; WIP JSON kept out of data/ deliberately). Blocked on LF-033: with the lance dominated, cheap-mass is the only build that clears hard, so the level grades single-solution at every weight swept. Fix the lance first, then re-sweep
